top_navigation.structure: Fixed at top, white background, border-b border-slate-200. Three sections: Left (Search), Center (Tabs), Right (Profile/Actions). It MUST be exactly the Plena shell.
top_navigation.search: Left-aligned, gray background (bg-slate-100), rounded-full, placeholder 'Her yerde ara...', magnifying glass icon on the left.
top_navigation.tabs: Center-aligned. Items: Ana Sayfa, Takım, İç İletişim, İK, Takvim. Active tab: text-blue-500, border-b-2 border-blue-500, icon active. Inactive tab: text-slate-500, hover:text-slate-700.
top_navigation.right_actions: Role switcher (Admin/Çalışan simple toggle), Settings Gear (gray), Bell icon with unread red badge (absolute -top-1 -right-1), Avatar circle with initials ('ST') and text 'PROFİLİM'.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

cards.pastel_widget: Solid pastel background (no shadow), rounded-xl, p-4 or p-6. Icon on left/top, title and description.
cards.white_card: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm rounded-xl p-5.

grids_and_layouts.main_content: flex-1 w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8
grids_and_layouts.module_discovery_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grids_and_layouts.admin_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8 where left is sidebar/filters and right is content

motion.tab_switch: relative, use framer-motion layoutId for the active tab underline if possible, or simple CSS border transition.
motion.modals: Fade in and scale up slightly (duration-200)

accessibility.aria_labels: Required on all icon-only buttons (bell, settings).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs).

instructions_to_main_agent.phase_1_setup: Set up React Router with the App Shell. Implement the exact Plena Top Navigation. Add a Mock Role Switcher (Admin vs Çalışan) in the top right. ALL text MUST be in Turkish.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_2_discovery: Build the 'İç İletişim' Discovery Screen for Employee. Show a grid of scalable categories. 'Duyurular' is active and expanded, showing the latest 2-3 announcements.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_3_admin_engine: Build the Admin Category Definition Engine. Allows drag-drop ordering of categories, icon picker, status toggle, and audience segmentation.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_4_announcements: Build the Announcement Create Form (title, body, image upload, sub-category, audience multi-select, channels like Mail/Push/SMS). Add Approval flow statuses (Draft, Pending, Published, Passive). Build the Admin list view with filters.
instructions_to_main_agent.phase_5_employee_view: Build the Employee Announcement Feed and Detail View. Add the 'Öne Çıkanlar' (Featured) pinned strip at the top of the feed.
instructions_to_main_agent.component_details: Use Shadcn UI for complex interactives (Select, Dialog, Tabs, Table). Build custom pastel cards for the discovery grid to match the HR page screenshot exactly.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (e.g. sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Avoid using complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
